title: N1 Shin Guard IMPACT
description:
Lightweight high-impact shin guard designed to provide maximum protection without compromising mobility. 
 Its  high-impact polymer outer shell  works together with an  impact-absorbing inner foam layer , cushioning and dispersing energy to reduce the risk of injuries from direct hits or tackles.

title: Elbow Protek Sleeves
description:
High-performance compression elbow sleeves specifically designed for football goalkeepers. 
 Engineered to protect one of the most exposed areas during goalkeeper actions, they feature a strategically placed impact-absorbing panel that reduces the intensity of contact against artificial turf and hard surfaces.

title: Knee Protek Sleeves
description:
High-performance compression knee pad specifically designed for football goalkeepers. 
 Engineered to protect one of the most exposed areas during saves, dives and ground contact, it features a high-density impact-absorbing panel that reduces contact intensity against artificial turf and hard surfaces.

title: N1 Shin Guard Holders
description:
Compression shin guard holder designed to keep shin guards securely in place without the need for tape. 
  
 Made from high-performance elastic fabric, it features a  front external pocket  where the shin guard is inserted, keeping it firmly positioned throughout training and competition.

title: N1 Beanie
description:
Training beanie designed for goalkeepers who don’t stop when temperatures drop. 
  
 Winter and night training sessions demand more than attitude. Maintaining body temperature is essential to preserve focus, muscle activation and performance between the posts.

title: N1 Thermal Neck
description:
Training neck warmer designed for goalkeepers who perform in the toughest conditions. 
 Cold weather directly impacts muscle activation and concentration. Keeping the neck area protected helps maintain body temperature and sustain high performance during night sessions or winter training. 
  
 Its technical fabric provides lightweight thermal insulation without adding bulk or restricting movement.
